Getting in

The lock is local to the phone — no account, no server, no password reset.

What a warden opens the app to see.

The property

Hostel → floor → room → bed, filled in once and edited later.

Tenants

Wardens think room-first, name-second, so room and bed sit next to the name everywhere.

Rent

Invoices generate themselves; everything else is a deliberate act.

Money out and records

Settings

Dark mode

Asked for by wardens working in dim common areas at night. It adjusts the same status colours rather than inventing its own.

Hindi

Hindi is a first-class language, not a retrofit. The switcher is independent of the phone's own locale.

Sample data only — the tenants, rooms and amounts here were typed into a test device to exercise the app, and no real person’s details appear. Lodgy stores everything on the phone and requests no internet permission, so nothing in these screens ever left the device.
